title: Light Croatian Manchego Lasagna
description: A savory and kid-friendly Croatian dish featuring Manchego cheese, pasta water emulsion, and low sodium content, served on a cedar plank.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions, reserving 1 cup of pasta water.
In a large bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, Manchego cheese, and reserved pasta water, mixing until smooth.
In a separate bowl, mix the olive oil, dried oregano, and salt-free seasoning blend.
Spread a thin layer of the olive oil mixture on the cedar plank.
Begin building the lasagna by spreading a layer of the cheese mixture on the plank, followed by a layer of noodles.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Cover the plank with aluminum foil and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
